data.topic: Moving every skill's MACHINE ROUTER section out of SKILL.md into a sibling ROUTER.md. Answer RQ-1 to RQ-5 in spec.md: every reader of the machine router with file:line; how each of the seven runtimes loads a skill; what the agent needs at run time versus what only scripts read; how a hub's MACHINE ROUTER joins its existing root ROUTER.md without breaking the router replay mode projection; and a migration that holds the routing baseline with a measured token saving.
